card.name: Words singling out one patient
card.fires_on: Words like "given", "each", or "single" that come before "patient" or "individual's", picking out one person. Also a blank spot before a body-weight phrase like "60 to 70 kg man".

modes.label: Any given patient
modes.description: The word "given" after "any" and before "patient" in the suicidality warning.

modes.label: Each or single individual
modes.description: Words like "each" or "single" that point to one person, before "individual's" or "patient".
modes.example: should be adjusted to<< each>> individual's response and tolerance.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward a single-person noun and away from "individual" itself, since that is already implied.
card.plain: It marks words that point to one particular patient, just before the noun naming that person.
